label: Influenza A/PR8 acute lung injury and dysplastic regeneration
scope_note: Study parameters only. This file contains NUMBERS. What a marker IS lives in config/lung_marker_registry.json and is never restated here.

requires.note: Symbols are RESOLVED against the registry at load time. A profile that redefines a marker's aliases, role or localization is invalid: contract/ifq_contract.py rejects any 'markers' object key inside a profile.

damaged.definition: parenchyma lacking AT1 coverage: AGER-negative territory at alveolar scale

intact.role: QC / biological negative, not an endpoint denominator

units.damage_sigma_um: um, Gaussian sigma of the local-density kernel

calibration.criterion: alpha = 0.01 false-positive area fraction on uninfected lung

applies_to.note: Outside this envelope a module MUST refuse to load these numbers. Re-derive on that model's own uninfected/untreated controls.

background_characterisation.component_filter_effect: 50 um2 filter moves 4.51e-4 -> 4.40e-4, so the background is NOT scattered specks
background_characterisation.consequence: A pod-area endpoint on this panel carries an irreducible ~4.4e-4 area-fraction floor. Report it; do not claim a smaller effect than the floor.

design.status: PILOT -- n=1 per group cell. No inferential statistic is defensible at this n; the pipeline reports mean/sd/sem/n_mice and the n is the honest answer.

provenance_note: Every module that loads this file records it in provenance.inputs[] with role 'injury_model_profile', its sha256, and profile_version, and copies thresholds.*.status=='LOCKED' values into provenance.parameters.locked with a matching lock_source pointer.
